lines.before: 9. **Credit and keep a safe copy.** Each third-party plugin or skill is credited (author, source, license) in `vendor/CREDITS.md` and kept as a pinned backup once its license allows. Read a community skill before first use. Upstream changes enter only through a reviewed `snapshot` and kit bump. Why: credit is owed, and a skill gone upstream must not take the method with it. *Check: tests confirm every backup is credited.*
lines.after: 9. **Credit and keep a safe copy.** Each third-party plugin or skill is credited (author, source, license) and kept as a pinned backup once its license allows, in the private backup repo `vendor.dir` names (the kit keeps `vendor-index.json`). Process skills have one home, the kit's own; a third-party copy stays a backup. Read a community skill before first use. Upstream changes enter only through a reviewed `snapshot` and kit bump. Why: credit is owed, and a skill gone upstream must not take the method with it. *Check: tests confirm every backup is credited.*
